# Year Picker

Choose one year from a compact paged year grid.

## Usage

### Graduation year

Choose one graduation year from a paged year grid.

<ComponentExample component="year-picker" scenario="graduation-year" title="Graduation year" description="Choose one graduation year from a paged year grid." :index="0" />

### Planning window

Choose a planning year from the active page of years.

<ComponentExample component="year-picker" scenario="planning-window" title="Planning window" description="Choose a planning year from the active page of years." :index="1" />

### Controlled

Let the parent own the current value and apply accepted changes back to the component.

## Floating positioning

This component uses the shared positioning engine. Use the [live positioning example](/guide/positioning) to change `side`, `align`, offsets, collision boundaries, strategy, and tracking while inspecting the resolved placement.

## Style available and selected dates

Style availability and selection from the public ARIA state on calendar cells. You do not need a second visual-only list that can drift from the component policies.

```css
[data-scope='year-picker'][data-part='cell'][aria-selected='true'] {
  background: CanvasText;
  color: Canvas;
}

[data-scope='year-picker'][data-part='cell'][aria-disabled='true'] {
  opacity: .45;
  text-decoration: line-through;
}
```

For SSR or tests that need a stable initial month, set the API `referenceDate` so the first rendered view does not depend on the current clock.

## Accessibility

The labeled input and trigger own a paged year grid with selected, highlighted, and disabled cells.
